Find DBH–height models usable with your data

Source: R/hd_model_registry.R
find_hd_models.Rd

Filters hd_model_registry() by jurisdiction and species, and reports which required predictors each candidate model needs that you do not have. Models with missing predictors are kept (as near-misses) so you can see what extra data would make them usable. No model is selected automatically; see hd() for automatic selection.

Usage

find_hd_models(jurisdiction = NULL, species = NULL, available = "DBH")

Arguments

jurisdiction

Optional character vector of province/territory codes (e.g. "ON"). Models covering any of them are kept. NULL (default) applies no filter.

species

Optional character vector of NFI species codes (e.g. "PICE.MAR"). Models covering any of them are kept. NULL (default) applies no filter.

available

Character vector of predictor argument names you can supply (e.g. c("DBH", "BA", "TPH")). Names follow the hd_*() argument names, which are case-sensitive.

Value

The matching rows of hd_model_registry() with species coverage (species, n_species, species_text), plus missing_predictors (list-column of required predictors not in available) and usable (logical). Usable models are listed first.

See also

hd_model_registry(), get_hd_model_info()

Examples

find_hd_models(jurisdiction = "ON", species = "PICE.MAR",
               available = c("DBH", "BA", "TPH"))
#> # A tibble: 5 × 23
#>   model_id engine  rank fixed_args   reference scope province_scope stand_origin
#>   <chr>    <chr>  <dbl> <list>       <chr>     <chr> <list>         <chr>       
#> 1 sharmaz… hd_sh…    75 <named list> @SharmaZ… prov… <chr [1]>      both        
#> 2 sharmaz… hd_sh…    45 <named list> @SharmaZ… prov… <chr [1]>      both        
#> 3 sharmap… hd_sh…    80 <list [0]>   @SharmaP… regi… <chr [1]>      both        
#> 4 sharma2… hd_sh…    85 <named list> @Sharma2… prov… <chr [1]>      natural     
#> 5 sharma2… hd_sh…    85 <named list> @Sharma2… prov… <chr [1]>      plantation  
#> # ℹ 15 more variables: bc_region <chr>, equation_family <chr>,
#> #   required_predictors <list>, optional_predictors <list>, region_arg <chr>,
#> #   prediction_types <list>, calibration_published <lgl>, params_key <chr>,
#> #   species_manual <list>, description <chr>, species <list>, n_species <int>,
#> #   species_text <chr>, missing_predictors <list>, usable <lgl>
